_about: One user message per form and person, and what scoring expects. 'aliases': blank id (or ids joined by ',' meaning any of them) -> aliases that blank must carry (rule 3). 'facts': blank id -> regex (case-insensitive) a readable fact or a message fact must match there (reported beside rule 3, not part of it).

single.message: I'm applying for a short-stay Schengen visa for a holiday in Italy, flying into Rome on 14 May 2027 and leaving on 28 May 2027. I'm single, I work as a staff nurse in Singapore on an employment pass, I've never had Schengen fingerprints taken, and I'm paying for everything myself.
